title: 11 — Security & Privacy Model
summary: Defines Atlas's security and privacy contracts: confirmation gates, per-agent least-privilege OAuth scopes, local-only sensitive capture, secrets handling, D1 audit log, and phishing/2FA rules.
notes: Content signals dominate: per-agent OAuth scope table, audit_log JSON schema, config knob table, and explicit gate mechanics make this a technical contract (SPEC) rather than user-facing requirements (PRD). Derived from SPEC-CANON §12 (with §5.8, §7, §8). No decision/consequences structure, so not an ADR.
